how.heading: From application to decision in four steps
how.sub: The same path for every service. You can stop at any step and continue later under My cases.

steps.title: Start the service
steps.body: Choose it from the catalog and sign in with your state ID.

steps.title: Fill in and sign
steps.body: Upload your documents. Co-owners or founders sign by a secure link.

steps.title: Pay the state fee
steps.body: Pay online. Your case moves on once the bank confirms the payment.

steps.title: Receive the decision
steps.body: An official reviews the case and the certificate arrives by email.

help.heading: Common questions

faq.a: Use your state ID. You sign in once and every service in the portal recognises you.

faq.q: Can I stop halfway and continue later?
faq.a: Yes. Your case is saved after every step. Open My cases to pick it up where you left it.

faq.q: How do co-owners or founders sign?
faq.a: Each of them receives a personal, time-limited link by email. They don't need an account to confirm.
When the bank reports it to us. Closing the payment page early does not lose the payment.
